caption: The video captures a white ceramic cup with its handle on the left, resting in a bed of roasted coffee beans spread across a folded tan burlap cloth against a uniform black background. A plume of pale, semi-transparent steam is already rising from the cup's rim when the excerpt opens and continues to ascend throughout. The column of vapor continuously morphs, its width, swirl pattern, and brightness shifting from frame to frame as wisps curl, thin, and reform while climbing. The vapor narrows and widens, its edges curling and dissipating as it climbs toward the top of the frame. The cup itself, the scattered beans, and the soft folds of the burlap remain fixed in position and appearance, showing no translation or deformation. The framing stays constant across the segment, with no detectable camera movement altering the composition. The steam thus forms the only visible motion, a slow, evolving drift already underway at the first frame and still ongoing at the last.
relations: Steam rises continuously from the cup's rim, morphing in width and swirl as it climbs.
Wisps curl, thin, and reform while ascending toward the top of the frame.
The cup, scattered beans, and burlap folds remain fixed in position and appearance.
Camera framing stays constant, leaving the evolving vapor as the only visible motion.
